Commentary.Commentary: Right then, South Africa go 1-0 up in this three-match ODI series. This game also brings curtains on a fantastic ODI career of Ben Stokes. The show must go on though and both these sides will lock horns again in the second ODI on Friday, 22nd of July. That game will start at 5.30 pm IST (12 pm GMT). Our build-up though begins a lot earlier. So do join us for the same. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Rassie van der Dussen WINS THE PLAYER OF THE MATCH AWARD for his sensational ton. He says it was a pretty hot day. Mentions it was good day to win the toss. Adds they planned to come into this tour and play smartly. They aimed to hit the gaps and run between the wickets. Also says their innings did not see a maximum which is hardly ever seen. Informs they are happy with their batting performance and would look into it tomorrow.

Keshav Maharaj, the skipper of South Africa says that the boys were clinical. Adds that Quinton de Kock and Malan set the platform and Rassie van der Dussen played a special innings. Mentions that partnerships were the key. Also says that Markram is a handy allrounder whose bowling is underrated. In the end says Nortje knows about his role and he stuck to his discipline. Says that it was quite hot out there which reminded him of home. Also informs that Andile Phehlukwayo is all fine and jokingly adds that he underestimated his size.

Jos Buttler, the skipper of England, says that it was a tough day in the heat and they just could not break the partnership and it was a fantastic partnership between Rassie van der Dussen and Aiden Markram. Tells that they could not get the breakthrough in the middle overs and they also did not impose themselves with the bat and adds that the wicket got slower and lower as the game progressed. Mentions that South Africa were smarter and executed their plans well. Says that they are improving with the games they are playing and adds that with some senior players not around now, they need to regroup as a team. He thanks Stokes for everything he has done for English cricket in the ODI format and tells that he always gives his 100 per cent and says that he has been the fantastic ambassador in ODI cricket and they will miss him.
Presentation time...

Earlier in the game, the partnership between Rassie van der Dussen and Markarm helped South Africa put a mammoth total on the board. Rassie van der Dussen scored a century hile Markram and Malan notched up their fifties. England bowled well in the death with their slower deliveries but were below par in the rest of the innings. South African bowlers used the same ploy that England used in the death and in end it proved too much for the English batters on this slow and low pitch.

South Africa, on the other hand, were just brilliant in this game. They had their plans ready with the ball after seeing how the pitch behaved in the first half and though they got their first wicket in the 19th over, they never really let the game drift away from them. Once they got the first breakthrough which was provided by the skipper Keshav Maharaj, they made sure that they keep the pressure on. Markram turned out to be a man with the golden arm as he got two big wickets and all other bowlers then chipped in with some tight bowling. Nortje bowled with good heat and got three wickets in one over that sealed the deal for the Proteas in the end.

The target was a stiff one for England but given the firepower England have in their ranks, they would have fancied chasing down this total. However, the pitch was a tricky one and England openers started off cautiously and managed to put together a stand of 102-run. However, once that partnership was broken, England continued to lose wickets at regular intervals and the required rate started creeping up. Root held one end up and also scored at a brisk rate but with over 10 runs an over needed in the last 15 overs, they needed the likes of Livingstone and Moeen Ali to step up but it was not the case today and despite a fine knock of 86 from 77 balls from Root and a fifty from Bairstow, England have fallen well short of the target.

South Africa have registered a comprehensive win over the more-fancied English unit here at Chester-Le-Street. They were on the mark with their execution with both bat and ball while England just could not match up the execution level and the intensity of the Proteas in this game. This was a special game for England as one of their greatest all-rounders was playing his last game in this format but sadly they have not been able to give him a fitting farewell.

OUT! CAUGHT! Anrich Nortje ends the innings with a four-fer. Back of a length, on off. Brydon Carse looks to heave it across the line. It catches the toe-end and flies towards long on. Dwaine Pretorius pouches it safely. SOUTH AFRICA WIN THE GAME BY 62 RUNS.
Commentary.Howout: c Dwaine Pretorius b Anrich Nortje

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Brydon Carse goes down the leg side, Anrich Nortje follows him with a slow short ball. Carse misses his pull attempt. Wide called.
Back of a length, on middle. Carse looks to hook it away but misses.
FOUR! Up and over! Carse is on a roll here. Full length, on off. Carse lofts it straight over the bowler's head for four.
Length ball, on the pads, Carse flicks it past the diving mid-wicket fielder. They take two.
Slower bumper, on middle Potts goes to the leg side and punches it to point for a quick single.
FOUR! Brydon Carse giving the fans something to cheer. It is short and on off. Carse comes down the track and swings hard at it. It goes over backward point off the outside edge and finds a boundary.
Slower ball, full length, on off. Carse chips it to deep mid-wicket but it lands safely. The batters take two.
Full length, around middle. Potts clips it through square leg for a single.
Full length, on fourth stump, an off pace delivery yet again. Potts tries to chase it but misses.
A slower length ball, outside off. Carse reaches out and lofts it towards mid on. The batters cross for a single.
Length ball, on off. Potts pushes it to covers for one.
Matthew Potts is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Anrich Nortje picks up three wickets in the over. The job is almost done for South Africa. It is a short ball, on off. Adil Rashid stays back and looks to hook it away. It flies off the top-edge towards the keeper. Quinton de Kock dances around the helmet and eventually pouches it safely. South Africa are just a wicket away now from victory.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Anrich Nortje

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! A short ball, down leg. Rashid leaves it alone. Wide called by the umpire.
Adil Rashid is the new batter in.

OUT! LBW! Anrich Nortje gets his second wicket of the over and it is all going downhill for England now! Anrich Nortje has been superb today with his yorkers and bouncers. This time he dished out a yorker on off. Curran gets across and looks to scoop it but misses. The ball hits his pads and there is an appeal. The umpire raises his finger and Curran walks back disappointed.
Short on off. Carse pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Brydon Carse comes in at number 9.

OUT! BOWLED! Anrich Nortje gets rid of Root and have to say South Africa have now sealed the deal with this wicket. On a length, angling into leg. Root goes for a wild swing across the line. He gets the inside edge onto his thigh pad and the ball goes onto hit the stumps. Root is disappointed and South Africa now need 3 wickets to win this game.
Back of a length, outside off. Root looks to cut it but misses.
FOUR! A fullish delivery on leg. Root flicks it towards the cow corner for a boundary. Third boundary in a row for England now!

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Sam Curran! This is fuller and outside off. Curran makes room and hits it away wide and over mid off for a boundary. 13 from the over and 86 needed now from 36 balls!
FOUR! Boundary for England and it is Curran who gets a much-needed boundary here! On a length, on off. Curran heaves it wide of long on for a boundary.
A slower fullish delivery on leg. Root flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
This is a knuckle ball, down the leg side. Root goes for a reverse-lap but misses.
Root skips down the track and makes a bit of room there. Dwaine Pretorius follows him and bowls it full. Root flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
This is fuller and outside off. Root hits it to sweeper cover for a couple.

Another nasty bouncer on middle. Curran ducks under it. However, the South African skipper goes for the DRS for a caught behind. The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows that the ball has hit the arm guard. So the original decsion stays. Curran will continue.

Review! South Africa take a review for caught behind. The UltraEdge confirms that there is a spike as the ball passes the arm guard. The original decision is Not Out. The review does not work in South Africa's favor.
Bangs it short on off. Good nasty bouncer and Curran sways away from the line of the ball.
Back of a length, on middle. Root works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, around off. Root looks to guide it towards the third man region but misses.
Very full delivery on middle. Curran drives it to mid off and sets off for a single. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A run added to the total in the end.
Starts the new spell with a shorter delivery, around off at 144 kph. Curran pulls it wide of long on and runs two.
Tossed up, on middle. Root heaves it towards cow corner for a couple. 103 needed now from 48 balls!
FOUR! Root finally gets one away! On the shorter side, on middle. Root stays back and pulls it to mid-wicket fence for a boundary.

Root gets a bit lucky again! This is tossed up, outside off. Root skips down the track and looks to hit it away. He, however, gets a top edge but luckily it goes over the third man fielder for a couple.
Curran skips down the track and pushes this shorter-length delivery on off to mid off for a single.
Shorter in length and turning into leg. Root goes back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Tossed up on middle. Root dances down the track and looks to slog it across the line. He, however, gets a big top edge and the ball goes in the air but falls in the vacant mid on region. Two runs taken.
On a length, on middle. Root works it to deep square leg for a single. Brilliant over, just 4 from it. So 115 needed now from 54 balls!
Back of a length, on middle. Curran makes room and slaps it to long on for just a single.

In the air...but safe! A slower length delivery, around off. Root is early on his heave and hits it aerially towards deep mid-wicket. However, the ball falls short of the fielder there and a single is taken.
Slower length delivery, outside off. Curran hits it hard to long off for just a single.
On the shorter side again, angling into off from 'round the wicket. Curran makes room and hits it back to the bowler again.
Back of a length, on off. Curran slaps it back to the bowler.
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this match.
SIX! Lovely shot down the ground. It is floated and full, around off. Root dances down the track and smokes it over the long off fence. He moves to 63. England are 215/6 at end of Powerplay 2.
Slower through the air, on leg. Root reverse-sweeps it to short third man.
On the pads, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
Sam Curran comes down the track and pushes this full delivery to covers.
Length and outside off. Sam Curran punches it to cover.
On off, pushed to covers for one.
Length ball, on the pads, Curran flicks it to fine leg for a couple of runs now.
Length ball, on the stumps. Curran dabs it to point.
Back of a length, on off. Root pulls it to deep square leg for one more. These singles won't hurt South Africa.
Length ball, on middle. Curran flicks it to mid on and gets off the mark with a single.
Short ball, pulled off the ribs to mid-wicket for a single.
Full length, on the pads, Root clips it through mid-wicket and comes back for the second run.
Full, on the pads, Root clips it to mid-wicket for a single. 200 is up for the hosts now.
On off, pushed to covers.
Sam Curran walks out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust! This time it is Moeen Ali. It is tossed up, on off. Moeen Ali gets low and tries to slog it away. It flies high in the air off the splice and goes towards mid-wicket. Dwaine Pretorius settles under it and makes no mistake. South Africa in complete control now.
Commentary.Howout: c Dwaine Pretorius b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: LEG BYE! It is full and on the pads, Root misses his flick and it goes out off his pads. They collect a leg bye.
It is full and outside off, turns away a bit. Ali drives it through covers for a single.
It is down leg, Root whips it to deep square leg for one.
A wicket-taking over comes to an end! A length ball, on middle. Ali blocks it with straight bat to mid on.
Back of a length, outside off. Ali guides it through backward point for a couple of runs now.

Drinks break. South Africa are at the driver's seat now and with the required rate over 10, England need something special to pull this one off from here. They still have the firepower though and the onus will be on Moeen Ali who walks out to the middle now to support Root and take the game on from here.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Liam Livingstone goes back on just 10. Lungi Ngidi gets his first wicket of the innings. It is a full-length ball, wide outside off. Liam Livingstone shuffles across and swings hard at it. The ball takes the inside edge and shatters the stumps. This is the last thing England would've wanted to see.
Good length, on top of off. Liam Livingstone tries to heave it across the line but misses.
FOUR! Slapped! There is only one way for Liam Livingstone. It is short and on off. Liam Livingstone comes down the track and flat-bats it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off. Liam Livingstone comes down the track and tries to cut it away but misses.
This is pushed quicker, on middle and leg. Joe Root uses the depth of the crease to block it out.
Full and on off Livingstone lofts it over the bowler's head for a single.
Fifty for Root. This is his 36th half-century. It is full and on off. Root reverse-sweeps it to third man for one.
A half-tracker on middle. Liam Livingstone rocks back and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Pitches it on middle and turns into leg. Root glances it to deep square leg for just a single.
Tossed up on middle. Root works it to deep backward square leg for a couple.
WIDE! On the shorter side and turning down the leg side. Root looks to pull it but misses.
Single to end the over and 151 needed now from 90 balls! This is fuller on leg. Root flicks it to deep square leg and takes a single.
Keeps it on middle and leg line. Root clips it to deep backward square leg for a couple.
Goes full on middle. Liam Livingstone flicks it to fine leg for a single.
On a length, on middle. Liam Livingstone gets a bit across and works it towards the leg side.
A low full toss on middle at 108 kph. Root looks to reverse-scoop it again but this time hits it to backward point for a single.
FOUR! Funky and very effective from Root! This is full and around off. Root reverse-scoops it over short third man for a boundary.
Keeps it a tad short again, on middle. Root works it to mid-wicket for a single.
On the shorter side, around off. Root punches it to deep point for a couple.
Shamsi keeps it on the same line. Liam Livingstone this time sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Tossed up on leg. Root sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
On middle and leg again. Liam Livingstone glances it to deep square leg for a single.
Turning into leg. Liam Livingstone looks to clip it away but gets the leading edge and luckily for him the ball falls short of the mid-wicket fielder.
Dot to end the over! A fuller delivery on off. Root reverse-scoops it but straight to the fielder at short third man.
This is nice bowling, keeping it straight. A length delivery on middle at 116 kph. Liam Livingstone knocks it down to long on for a single.
On a length, on middle. Liam Livingstone drives it back to the bowler.
A fullish delivery, outside off. Liam Livingstone drives it firmly to mid off.
Goes fuller on middle. Root clips it to long on for a single.
Nicely played! On a length, on middle. Root tucks it towards the fine leg fence and comes back for the second run before the fielder cuts it off.
Liam Livingstone is the new man in. Also, Dwaine Pretorius comes into the attack now.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Jos Buttler departs and England are losing their way now! It is Shamsi, who strikes this time and South Africa are putting some real pressure on England now. Jos Buttler skips down the track a bit early and Shamsi drags his length back. It is on middle and leg. Buttler looks to clip it away but gets the inside edge onto his pads. The ball loops up in the air back to the bowler off his pads and Shamsi takes a fine catch diving forward. England still need 170 runs!
FOUR! Brilliant from Buttler! Tossed up on off. Buttler skips down the track, reaches the pitch of the ball and slams it straight down the ground for a boundary.
On middle and leg again. Buttler works it to deep square leg for a couple.
Turning into Buttler from middle. Buttler goes back and pushes it to mid off.
This is flatter on middle. Root goes back and punches it to long on for a single.
On the shorter side on leg. Buttler goes back and hits it aerially but short of the long off fielder for a single.
Tabraiz Shamsi (3-0-9-0) is back into the attack now.
Shorter and around off. Root chops it to the point fielder. 178 needed now from 114 balls!
On the shorter side, around off. Root punches it to covers.
Darted on leg. Buttler works it to long on for a single.
Pushed quicker on middle. Buttler goes back and pushes it to covers.
Tossed up on middle. Root drives it to long off for a single.
A fuller delivery on leg. Buttler clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off. Jos Buttler lofts it towards long on for one. 8 runs off the over then.
A slider now, on leg. Jos Buttler comes down the track but is unable to get it away.
A single now as this is worked to long on.
Fuller, outside off. Buttler drives it to cover for a single.
Length, on off. Root goes back and strokes it through covers for a single. 150 up for England.
FOUR! Incredible shot. It is full and outside off. Joe Root dances down the track and lofts it through the line towards long off. Boundary.
Looped up, on off, Root pushes it to long off for a single.
Floated and full, outside off. This one stays a bit low. Root kneels and tries to sweep it away but only connects with thin air.
Full length, on the pads, Buttler clips it to square leg and gets a single. He is off the mark.
Full length, outside off. Root drives it to long off for a single.
Length, outside off. Root punches it to cover.
On off, blocked out.
Jos Buttler walks out to the middle.

OUT! LBW! Aiden Markram sends back the man of the moment on a timid score. Ben Stokes scores just 5 runs in his final innings, he departs to a standing ovation. It is tossed up, full and on middle and leg. Ben Stokes goes for the reverse sweep but misses it completely. He gets rapped on his pads. Markram appeals and the umpire raises his dreaded finger. Stokes has a word with Root on the other end but the timer runs out and he eventually walks back to the pavilion.
Outside off, Root punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
SIX! Great use of the feet by Root. It is tossed up, full and on off. Joe Root comes down the track and smokes it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
On off, blocked out.
This one turns in sharply. It is tossed up, around off. Joe Root goes back to defend it out.
Floated and full, on off. Stokes drives it to long off for one.
Full and angled into the pads, Root tucks it to mid-wicket. Only three off the over.
Fuller, on off. Stokes drives it to cover for a single.
Flatter, outside off. Ben Stokes punches it to covers.
Around off, pushed to covers for a single.
Full and on off. Root reverses it to point.
Looped up, on off. Ben Stokes eases it to mid on for a single.

Dwaine Pretorius is marking out his run-up with the help of a tape here. He is done with the one end and now goes to another side to mark his run-up there too. However, we have to wait a little to see him bowl today as Keshav Maharaj continues.
On the stumps, Root punches it through covers on the back foot for a brace.
WIDE! Aiden Markram has to reload his final delivery. It is floated and full, down leg. Joe Root tries to sweep but misses. Wided.
Tossed up, outside off. Ben Stokes drives it to wide of long off for a single.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Ben Stokes flicks it to mid-wicket.
Quicker and full, on off. Stokes reverse-sweeps but straight to the fielder.
Length and on off. Stokes pushes it to cover.
Darted on the pads, Stoke flicks it to mid-wicket. Not in the gap.
Nicely bowled! This is a loopy delivery on off. Root leans forward and pushes it to covers.
Dwaine Pretorius is a concussion replacement for Andile Phehlukwayo.
Tossed up, on off. Root pushes it to extra cover.
Pushed quicker on off. Root punches it to covers off the back foot.
Looped up, on off, defended out.
Ben Stokes is off the mark. A length ball, on off. Stokes hits it to long on for one.
Full and outside off. Root drives it through covers for a single.
Ben Stokes comes in at number 4. The whole crowd is on its feet to greet the homeboy, who walks out for his final stint in the 50-over format.

OUT! LBW! Aiden Markram strikes and the move to bring Aiden Markram into the attack has worked wonders for South Africa here. This is floated up, pitched on off and turns into Jonny Bairstow. He looks to sweep it but misses. The ball hits his pads and the umpire raises his finger after a loud appeal. Jonny Bairstow though reviews it. The UltraEdge shows no bat involved. The Ball Tracking shows three reds and the original decision will stay. Jonny Bairstow walks back after a fine knock and this is a big breakthrough for the Proteas.
Slower through the air, around off. Jonny Bairstow drives it to mid off.
Tossed up, around off. Root skips down the track and pushes it to long on for a single.
Pushed quicker on middle. Root works it to mid-wicket.
On the shorter side, turning into middle. Root goes back and punches it to covers.
FOUR! Aiden Markram is greeted with a boundary here by Root! This is fuller one on off. Root reverse-sweeps it through backward point for a boundary.

It looks like Jonny Bairstow is struggling with a cramp. He has called out for the physio for some treatment and fluids to run down his body. It might be the heat causing the cramp. This will also give some time for the players to have a short drinks break. England look to be in control with plenty of wickets in hand. South Africa need wickets in quick succession here to get back in the game. They would also gladly welcome back Andile Phehlukwayo on the field as it can be costly to lose his overs. Aiden Markram comes into the attack now.
Floated up on middle. Jonny Bairstow looks to go for a big slog-sweep but he gets the toe-end of his blade. The ball goes onto hit his helmet and deflects towards short third man.
FOUR! Brilliant placement! On the shorter side on middle. Jonny Bairstow goes deep in his crease and half-pulls it in the gap towards the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Goes fuller on off. Jonny Bairstow reverse-sweeps it to deep point for a couple.
Slower through the air, on off. Root knocks it down to long off for a single.
Shorter in length and around off. Jonny Bairstow punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Jonny Bairstow drives it to covers.
Back of a length, on middle at 145 kph. Root works it to mid-wicket. Just a run from the over and a excellent one from Nortje.
Another pacy bouncer around off. Joe Root lets it go.

So two yorkers are followed by a pacy bouncer on off. It is at 148 kph. Jonny Bairstow looks to pull it but gets a top edge. The ball though falls short of Lungi Ngidi at fine leg and a single is taken.
Another yorker on middle. Jonny Bairstow blocks it out again.
Brilliantly bowled! Anrich Nortje nails a yorker on off at 149 kph. Jonny Bairstow though does well to put his bat down in time.
Lands on a length, on off. Jonny Bairstow drives it back to the bowler.
Slower through the air and floated on middle. Root clips it to mid-wicket off the front foot.
Keshav Maharaj serves it a tad short on middle. Root goes deep in his crease and works it to deep backward square leg for a couple.
Darted on leg. Jonny Bairstow works it towards short fine leg and a quick single is taken.
On the shorter side, around off. Jonny Bairstow goes back and punches it to covers.
A flatter delivery on middle. Jonny Bairstow works it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on leg. Jonny Bairstow works it towards backward square leg for a couple.
Back of a length, on off. Jonny Bairstow pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length, on off, blocked out.
Short, on leg, pulled to deep square leg for one more.

DROPPED! The ball was in the air for a long, long time but Lungi Ngidi never looked sure. It is a short ball, on the body. Jonny Bairstow is early into his pull. It takes the top-edge and goes towards deep square leg. Lungi Ngidi runs forward but is unable to gather it with both hands. They take one.
Short ball, on the body. Root pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Full length, strayed on the pads. Root flicks it to square on the leg side.
Joe Root walk out at number 3!

OUT! CAUGHT! Keshav Maharaj is delighted and so are his team-mates. Jason Roy departs in his 40s. He walks back an unhappy man. It is tossed up, around off. Jason Roy does not go through with his shot and chips it towards wide long off. David Miller sprints to his left and gathers the ball safely. Can South Africa build on this wicket?
Commentary.Howout: c David Miller b Keshav Maharaj

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Jason Roy hits it hard and flat. Full and on off. Jason Roy reverse-sweeps it through point for a boundary.
On off, pushed to covers.
Full and on the pads, Jonny Bairstow flicks it to square leg for a single. He gets to his half-century. He has been in sublime form for England througout the summer.
Floated and full, on off. Jonny Bairstow dabs it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, on middle. Roy reverse-sweeps it to the right of point. Lungi Ngidi dives to that side to make a stop.
Change in bowling. As Andile Phehlukwayo is off the field, the skipper Keshav Maharaj decides to bring himself on.
Full length, on off. Bairstow pushes it back to the bowler. Another good over for England. They are on the right path here.

Andile Phehlukwayo seems to be in pain here. He is still not back on his feet and it seems that the collision seems to have hurt him here. The medical team is on the field and hopefully he will be fine soon. So, he is back on his feet now but is walking off the field. Looks fine though and we have to wait and see whether he will take further part in this game or not.

FOUR! A bit of collision in the field and the ball races away to the boundary and Jonny Bairstow to 49. It is a length ball, on off. Jonny Bairstow drives it down the ground. Andile Phehlukwayo from mid off and Keshav Maharaj from mid on attack the same ball. They collide and Andile Phehlukwayo is down on the ground, while the ball races away.
Good length, outside off. Jonny Bairstow gets an inside edge on the pitch.
FOUR! Cracking shot! It is on a length, outside off. Jonny Bairstow stays back and flays it through covers for a boundary.

LEG BYE! Full length, drifting down leg. Roy looks to flick but misses. It goes towards fine leg off his pads. Quinton de Kock gives it a chase and only allows the batters to collect a single leg bye.
Full length ball, outside off. Jonny Bairstow drives it to mid off for one.
On a length, on off. Bairstow hits it to long on for a single. A good over for the hosts.
Deft touch! It is full, just outside off. Jonny Bairstow guides it down to third man for a boundary.
On off, defended out.
LEG BYE! Full length, angled down leg. Jonny Bairstow misses his flick, it goes off his pads towards fine leg. They collect two leg byes.
Fuller, on off. Roy drives it through covers for a single.
It is full and on the pads, Jonny Bairstow flicks it aerially to deep mid-wicket. Anrich Nortje runs to his left from deep square leg but does not charge towards the ball. They take one.
A dot to end the over! Floated, around off. Roy slaps it to mid off on the back foot. Just 4 runs off the over then.
This one is tossed up, on middle. Jonny Bairstow works it to long on for one run.
Floated, down leg. Roy moves to that side and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
A dot now! Flighted and full, on the pads. Roy comes down the track and flicks it to mid-wicket.
On the pads, clipped to deep square leg for one.
Full length, on middle. Jonny Bairstow moves to the leg side and hits it to mid off.
WIDE! Quicker and full, down leg. Jonny Bairstow is unable to tickle it away. Wided.
A length ball, on off, defended out.
TWO BYES! Good length, on top of off. Jason Roy shuffles across and tries to scoop it away but misses. Quinton de Kock fails to grab it and it goes towards fine leg. They collect two byes.
Length ball, on off. Jonny Bairstow pushes it to mid on for a single.
Back of a length, on middle. Roy pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Roy defends this full length delivery to mid off.
Length ball, on fourth stump. Bairstow punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller, wide outside off. Roy slashes it hard to mid off but does not find the gap. Roy was waiting for this wider delivery but is unable to capitalize on it.
Fuller, down leg. Jonny Bairstow flicks it to deep square leg. Andile Phehlukwayo fumbles. The batters think for the second run but decides against it.
Floats it up, on off, blocked out.
Flatter one, on the pads. Roy clears his front leg and whacks it to deep square leg. He finds the fielder in the deepp and they take one.
On off, blocked back to the bowler.
Tossed up, on off. Roy hits it back to the bowler. Shamsi gets an hand to it and kills the pace.

Drinks break. It has been a cautious start from the English openers but they have done well to not give their wicket away. South Africa have bowled well and would look to put more pressure on English batters with tidy lines and lengths. The off-pace deliveries are the way to go on this pitch and South Africa also have two quality spinners in their ranks. A crucial passage of play coming up...
Full length, on middle. Roy eases it to long on for a single. So, Andile Phehlukwayo goes for 7 in his first over.
Full length, down leg. Roy clips it to deep square leg for two more.
Good work in the deep! It is full and outside off. Roy creams it through the gap at covers. Aiden Markram covers a lot of ground to his right and makes a great stop with a slide. Two taken.
Another single now! Full length, outside off. Jonny Bairstow drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Touch short, outside off. Roy cuts it to deep point for a single.
BEATEN! It is a length ball which holds its line, outside off. Roy looks to punch it away on his back foot but misses.
Andile Phehlukwayo is into the attack now.
Fuller, down leg. Jonny Bairstow flicks it through mid-wicket, there is a misfield in the deep and the batters take two. A tidy start by Tabraiz Shamsi, only three runs off it.
Tossed up, full and on off. Jonny Bairstow gets it to point off the outer half.
Pushed through quicker, on leg. Jonny Bairstow misses his flick and gets rapped on the pads. Going down leg.
Second dot in the over! It is flatter, around off. Jonny Bairstow goes back and punches it to cover.
Darted on the pads, Roy whips it to deep square leg for a single.
Floated and full, outside off. Roy goes for reverse sweep only to find the fielder at backward point.
Tabraiz Shamsi is into the attack now.
Full length, on off. Jonny Bairstow drives it to mid on, but not in the gap. Two dots to end the over.

Full length, angled down leg. Jonny Bairstow misses his clips. It brushes his pads and goes to the left of the keeper. Quinton de Kock dives to that side and gathers the ball with two hands. He appeals for caught behind but the umpire thinks otherwise.
A single as this is punched down to long on.
WIDE! This is full, drifting down leg. Roy misses his flick. Wide called.
Length ball, on the pads, Jonny Bairstow tucks it to square leg for one more.
FOUR! Jonny Bairstow stepping on the throttle now! It is a short ball, on middle and leg. Jonny Bairstow picks up the length early and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length ball, angled into the pads. Jonny Bairstow stays back and flicks it to deep square leg for two runs.
Powerplay 1 comes to an end! That means 4 fielders can be placed outside the inner circle until the end of the 40th over.

Ohh...Miller drops a tough chance! Lungi Ngidi serves a length delivery, around off at 128 kph. Jonny Bairstow looks to drive it away but ends up playing way too early. The ball goes aerially towards mid off and Miller there jumps and gets a right hand to it. However, the ball does not stick and falls away from him. A single in the end.
Back of a length on middle and leg. Jonny Bairstow looks to clip it away. However, he misses and the ball hits him high on his pads. The ball rolls towards the off side.
Back of a length, on middle. Roy works it to fine leg for a single.
The slower nature of the pitch is making it difficult for the English batters to time the ball here. A length delivery, around off. Roy looks to punch it away but gets the bottom of his blade.
Back of a length, on off. Roy looks to defend but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
Once again the cutter. On a length, around off at 122 kph. Jonny Bairstow drives it left of mid off. The fielder there does well to dive and stop it. A single taken.
Bowls on a length, on middle at 149 kph. Jonny Bairstow works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Again Roy charges down the track to this length delivery on off. He gets the inside half of his blade but this time just a single to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Jason Roy has been quite sedate so far but it seems that he has decided to break the shackles now! On a length, on off. Roy dances down the track and swings across the line. The ball goes off the inside half of his blade towards the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Lands on a length, on off. Roy blocks it out towards the off side.
WIDE! Anrich Nortje drifts down the leg side at 144 kph. Roy looks to clip it away but misses.
Goes fuller on middle. Roy flicks it well but straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Back of a length, around off. Roy looks to punch it away but gets the inside edge onto his pads.
Now a misfield allows a single. On a length, on middle. Roy works it right of mid-wicket. The fielder there fails to collect it cleanly and a single is taken.

A slower fullish delivery, outside off. Jonny Bairstow looks to hit it down the ground but ends up only chipping up in the air towards mid on. However, the fielder is back at long on and so it is a comfotable single for Jonny.
Lands on a length, on off at 136 kph. Roy pushes it to long on for a single.
On a length, angling into the stumps. Jonny Bairstow works it towards backward square leg for a single.
Ngidi bowls it a tad short, around off. Roy skips down the track and looks to slap it towards the leg side. However, he only manages to get the inside edge onto his pads and a run is taken.
This is overpitched outside off. Roy drives and drives it to the cover fielder.
On a length, on middle. Jonny Bairstow works it to square leg.
FOUR! Jonny Bairstow picks the slower delivery and dispatches it. A fuller delivery on off. Jonny Bairstow drives and hits it firmly wide of mid off for a boundary.

Roy steps down the track and Anrich Nortje bangs it short around leg at 139 kph. Roy looks to pull it away but gets the inside edge onto his body. The ball rolls towards the leg side and a single is taken.
Lands on a length, around off. Roy fends it towards the off side.
Goes a bit fuller angling into leg at 142 kph. Roy looks to clip it away but misses. The ball hits his pads and there is an appeal for an LBW but the umpire turns it down.
Starts iff with a back-of-a-length delivery on off. Roy defends it off the bottom of his blade.
Anrich Nortje is into the attack now.
Overpitched and outside off. Roy drives but does not time it well. He manages to hit it left of mid off and takes a quick single. This has been a watchful start from the English openers.
Goes a bit fuller on middle. Jonny Bairstow works it right of mid on for a single.
A slower delivery that lands on a length, on off. Jonny Bairstow defends it watchfully.
Goes fuller on off. Jonny Bairstow drives it to mid off this time.
On a length, on off. Jonny Bairstow looks to push it towards the off side but gets the inside edge of his blade. The ball goes just past the off pole.
FOUR! A boundary for Jonny Bairstow and this will help his confidence. A fuller delivery on middle. Jonny Bairstow shows the full face of his blade and drives it past mid on for a boundary.
An arm ball angling into leg. Jonny Bairstow works it to square leg for a single.
Slower through the air and outside off. Jonny Bairstow pushes it to covers.
Darted on middle and leg. Roy works it to mid-wicket for a single.
On the shorter side, around off. Jonny Bairstow goes back and pushes it to point for a single.
Tossed up on off. Jonny Bairstow blocks it out.
A fuller delivery on leg. Jonny Bairstow looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. It is sliding down leg.
A fullish delivery on off. Roy drives it to mid off this time.
On the shorter side, around off. Roy defends it with the angled blade towards the point fielder.
Back of a length, on off. Roy defends it towards the cover fielder.

A fullish delivery on off. Jonny Bairstow pushes it to mid off and sets off for a single. Miller is alert there and charges towards the ball. He collects it and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Single in the end.
On a length, on middle. Roy works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Roy gets a bit lucky here but England will not mind it. Back of a length, around off. Roy steps down the track and looks to push it away. However, he gets the inside edge of his blade and the ball goes past the stumps wide of the keeper towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
It is full and on off. Roy hits it to long off for one. He retains the strike. After starting with a maiden, Maharaj goes for 9 in his second one.
Full and on leg, Jonny Bairstow clips it to fine leg for a single.
A single now as this is flicked to mid-wicket.
SIX! First signs of aggression from Roy!  Tossed up on middle. Roy slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Tossed up, on off, pushed to covers.
On off, defended out.
Lands on a length, on off. Jonny Bairstow solidly blocks it out.
Angling into the pads at 141 kph. Roy turns it away towards deep square leg for a single. There has been no sign of any swing from this new ball.
On a length, angling into off at 139 kph. Roy blocks it from his crease.
Serves a full delivery on middle. Roy hits it firmly but straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
A full delivery on the pads. Jonny Bairstow clips it to fine leg for a single.
Lungi Ngidi with a good yorker, right in the blockhole. Jonny Bairstow makes room to hit it away but ends up only blocking it out in the end.
NO BALL! Lungi Ngidi oversteps straight away! A length ball on middle. Jonny Bairstow defends it to mid on. A Free Hit coming up.
Lungi Ngidi to start with the second new ball.
A maiden to start from the South African skipper. This is a flighted delivery on off. Roy takes his front foot forward and blocks it out.
Nice loopy delivery on off. Roy just pushes it gently towards the off side.
Angles it into leg. Roy works it to short fine leg.
Pushed a bit quicker on off. Roy blocks it off the front foot.
Slower through the air, on off. Roy drives it to covers this time.
Starts off with a tossed up delivery on off. Roy pushes it off the inside half of his blade back to the bowler.
